rules.text: Global rule 1: never auto-cast a self or party buff whose buff type is already active from the 12 h board (Might and Attack Aura are both PA_UP, Shield and Defense Aura are both PD_UP, each dance has its own DANCE_OF_* type); a recast turns a 12 h buff into a 2 min dance or a 20 min aura. (?) Depends on whether the L2Toggle board uses the retail skill ids.
Global rule 2: check the weapon before casting. Dances and blade dances need DUAL; Backstab and the blows need DAGGER or DUALDAGGER; Vengeance, Magical Mirror and Shield Strike need a SHIELD.

Global rule 3: cubics, summons, Aura Flash, Erase, Betray, Prophecy of Wind and Chain Heal cost Spirit Ore 3031; Symbols, Cyclone, Anti-Summoning Field and Mass Recharge cost item 8875 or 8876 and have 30-60 min reuse. Check stock before casting.
Global rule 4: never auto-cast transformation stances: Vanguard 813 and Inquisitor 1522 are TRANSFORM, 6 h, and swap the whole skill bar.
Global rule 5: Symbols (Symbol of Defense 454, Noise 455, Assassin 460, Sniper 459) are NEVER auto: item 8875, 30 min reuse, and they dispel your own PHYSICAL_STANCE toggles on cast.

Order inside the party: the tank opens with Aggression 28 or Aura of Hate 18; DPS waits for 1-2 tank hits and daggers move behind the mob; the Saint then puts Stigma of Shilien 1539 on the tank's target; only after that do AoE skills fire (Demonic Blade Dance 408, Tempest 1176 / Aura Blast 1554, Multiple Shot 987), so the AoE does not pull aggro off the tank.
Aggro thieves to block in every non-tank bot: Aggression 28, Lure 51, Corpse Plague 103, Poisonous Cloud 1167, and Aura Flash 1417 used outside emergencies.

Tank MP is real: Guard Stance 288, Shield Fortress 322, Fortitude 335 and the hate skills drain it. The Saint's Recharge 1013 treats the Shillien Knight as a priority target (it has no Recharge skill, so the Recharge-class restriction does not apply).

Biggest uncertainties, verify in game: (1) whether the board buff ids match retail (decides whether dances and auras overwrite the board); (2) Phantom Summoner pet choice 56-78 (Nightshade 1333 vs Soulless 1278); (3) the real value of Focus Skill Mastery 334; (4) Smart Cubic behaviour (780 / 783).

Owner rule: healers ONLY heal. Every attack / CC / Inquisitor row of the Shillien Oracle / Elder / Saint line (and its Dark Elven Mystic base) is auto:false; Stigma of Shilien 1539 on the tank's target is the allowed exception.
Owner rule: all toggles only in fights (they drain MP); the guide's "always on" toggles are kept on during fights only.
